mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 7% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 7%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 3% YoY, combined with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 10% YoY, signals a supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 5% YoY signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of holiday seasons with RSAFS growth above 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25bps in a single month signals an abrupt shift in monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to surprise effect.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS decrease > 25bps.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 6%) and high payroll employment (PAYEMS > 130,000) signals a labor market at full capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected inflation pressures.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with UNRATE < 6% and PAYEMS > 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY) signals decreasing purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only when accompanied by a flat or decreasing GDP growth rate (GDPC1 < 2% YoY).
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 45% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY and GDPC1 < 2% YoY.
